{{Quote|In a secret lair on this planet, Baras has bound and indentured an ancient Sith spirit. He feeds off this spirit's power, stealing all her visions of the future. Everything he has built has come from her insights.|[[Darth Vowrawn]]|<ref name="Corellia" />}}
During the [[Galactic War]], the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]] and companions undertook a '''mission''' to the [[Battle of Corellia|embattled]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in order to locate the [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Vowrawn]] and destabilize the allies of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Baras]].<ref name="Corellia" />
